value.text:
We need to evaluate each claim against the evidence. Let's go through each claim.

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 0409-6648-02 is on the FDA shortage list as "Limited Availability" with FDA reason category "Other", manufacturer reports manufacturing delay, next delivery October 2026, estimated recovery December 2026." Cited: [shortage-0409-6648-02]

Evidence says: "FDA shortage list: Dextrose Monohydrate 50%, Injection, 25 g/50 mL (NDC 0409-6648-02) from Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company; availability: "Limited Availability"; FDA reason category: "Other"; next delivery: October 2026; estimated recovery: December 2026; manufacturer reports: Manufacturing Delay; updated 10/08/2026"

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock of 440 units covers 23.4 days at 18.8 units per day." Cited: [stock-12]

Evidence: "dextrose DEXTROSE MONOHYDRATE 25 g/50mL (Hospira, Inc., NDC 0409-6648-02, NDA019445): 440 units on hand, 18.8/day over 30 days, 23.4 days of cover"

Matches. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited: [search-recall-12]

Evidence: "Searched this run's FDA ongoing-recall snapshot for our package NDC 0409-6648-02 and product 0409-6648: no ongoing recall."

Matches. Supported.

Claim 4: substitution: "Current dextrose 25g/50mL from Hospira has 23.4 days of cover." Cited: [stock-12]

Same as claim 2 but from substitution agent. Evidence supports. Supported.

Claim 5: substitution: "Dextrose 50% from Otsuka ICU Medical (NDA018563) is therapeutically equivalent to the current product (both TE code AP)." Cited: [ob-NDA019445-001, ob-NDA018563-001]

Evidence ob-NDA019445-001: "Orange Book: DEXTROSE 50% 500MG/ML (INJECTABLE;INJECTION) by HOSPIRA INC, application NDA019445, TE code AP (our current product)"

Evidence ob-NDA018563-001: "Orange Book: DEXTROSE 50% IN PLASTIC CONTAINER 50GM/100ML (INJECTABLE;INJECTION) by OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC, application NDA018563, TE code AP"

Both have TE code AP. The claim says they are therapeutically equivalent (both TE code AP). That's correct. However, note that the concentration descriptions differ: "500MG/ML" vs "50GM/100ML". But both are dextrose 50% injection. The Orange Book TE code AP indicates therapeutic equivalence. The claim is supported.

Claim 6: substitution: "No packages of NDA018563 at this concentration are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-NDA018563]

Evidence: "Checked OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC NDA018563: 1 package(s) at our concentration in the FDA product listing (0990-7936-19 by ICU Medical Inc.: not on the FDA shortage list); no ongoing recall on these products. Result: none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list."

Matches. Supported.

Claim 7: substitution: "OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC NDA018563: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-NDA018563, ob-NDA018563-001, ob-NDA019445-001, ndc-0990-7936]

We need to check if all cited evidence supports the claim. The claim combines two facts: therapeutic equivalence (TE code AP) and none of its packages on shortage list. The evidence includes status-NDA018563 (which says none on shortage list), ob-NDA018563-001 (TE code AP for Otsuka), ob-NDA019445-001 (TE code AP for current product), and ndc-0990-7936 (NDC directory info). The claim says "OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC NDA018563: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." The therapeutic equivalence is relative to the current product? The claim doesn't explicitly say "to the current product", but it's implied. The evidence shows both have TE code AP, which means they are therapeutically equivalent to the reference listed drug, but not necessarily to each other? Actually, TE code AP means the product is therapeutically equivalent to the reference listed drug. If both have TE code AP, they are both therapeutically equivalent to the same reference listed drug, and thus considered therapeutically equivalent to each other (by FDA standards). So the claim is reasonable. The evidence supports both parts. The ndc-0990-7936 is just additional info about the package. Not needed but not contradictory. So claim is supported.

All claims appear supported. No factual problems. So unsupported list empty.
